normalized_lines.reading: Philosophus dicit: Verum sine mendacio, certum verissimum. Quod est superius
est sicut quod est inferius, et quod est inferius est sicut quod est superius, ad
penetranda miracula unius rei. Sicut omnes res ab
uno fuerunt meditatione unius. Et ⟨sicut⟩ nate fuerunt res omnes
ab hac re una ⟦...?⟧ aptatione. Pater eius sol, mater eius
luna. Portavit illud ventus in ventre suo. Nutrix eius est terra.
Pater omnis t[h?]elesmi totius mundi est hic. Vis eius integra est
si versa fuerit in terram. Separabis terram ab igne, subtile a spisso,
suaviter[que?] cum magno ingenio. Ascendit a terra in celum, iterumque
descendit in terram et recipit vim superiorum et inferiorum. Sic
[habuit?] gloriam totius mundi. Ideoque fugiet a te omnis
obscuritas. Hic est totius mundi fortitudinis fortis
fortitudo, quia vincet omnem rem subtilem et omnem rem solidam
penetrabit. Sicut [ergo?] mundus creatus est. Hinc erunt apta-
tiones mirabiles, quarum [modus?] hic est. Itaque vocatus sum
Hermes, tres totius mundi partes habens sapientie. Completum
est quod dixi de operatione solis et lune.

source_uncertainties.evidence: The upper red rubric is only partially read here. Its intervening word is not securely transcribed. It is not silently supplied from a catalogue title.
source_uncertainties.semantic_limit: Not part of the following 17-line body; no invented title Tabula smaragdina claimed as written rubric.

source_uncertainties.evidence: No independent et is confidently visible between these two words. The reading therefore does not supply the familiar extra conjunction.
source_uncertainties.semantic_limit: No material effect on truth-assertion content; a real transcription distinction.

source_uncertainties.evidence: Preferred native reading penetranda. The letter sequence and a repetition in 1v support this over the familiar perpetranda. No edition-based substitution made.
source_uncertainties.semantic_limit: Opening infinitival purpose and later penetrabit may share the penetrate verb family; the abstract object miracula does not force a literal physical penetration.

source_uncertainties.evidence: Sicut is visibly supplied above the line after Et, with overwritten/cancelled lower writing. The cancelled letters are not securely reconstructed. Nate is the preferred following reading. Commentary 1v has the corresponding lemma with fuerunt nate order.
source_uncertainties.semantic_limit: The corrected reading is represented, while the prior scribal state remains unresolved. No invented clean uncorrected et sicut line.

source_uncertainties.evidence: The contracted form is expanded meditatione, also supported by the 1v lemma. It is not normalized to mediatione.
source_uncertainties.semantic_limit: Meditation/thought or mediation is not automatically a laboratory operation; the precise philosophical sense and referent of unius remain open.

source_uncertainties.evidence: Preferred visible forms lack an extra initial ad-. The 1v/3v lemma repetitions support aptatione/aptationes.
source_uncertainties.semantic_limit: Do not silently adopt adaptatione/adaptationes from a different printed recension.

source_uncertainties.evidence: A possible h after initial t is unresolved; telesmi/thelesmi retained as spelling alternatives.
source_uncertainties.semantic_limit: The obscure loan term is not assigned an assured technical substance or translated as a confirmed ordinary noun.

source_uncertainties.evidence: A following contraction may be que; its attachment/reading is not fully secure. Main reading retains the uncertainty.
source_uncertainties.semantic_limit: Gentleness and great ingenium are both present regardless; no change to object identity inferred.

source_uncertainties.evidence: The compact verb is not securely expanded. Habuit is the present preferred visual reading, with habebit plausible if the abbreviation is expanded otherwise. Habebis is not silently installed from the familiar text. The 3v commentary has a compact related glory phrase but does not securely settle the main-text ending here.
source_uncertainties.semantic_limit: Person and tense, hence whether the implied ascending thing or addressed reader receives glory, remain unresolved.

source_uncertainties.evidence: Preferred reading includes the que contraction after ideo; no source-neutral reduction to ideo.
source_uncertainties.semantic_limit: The effect on obscurity is linked to preceding content, but the causal scope is not uniquely delimited.

source_uncertainties.evidence: Sicut is the preferred actual first word. The following abbreviated sign is provisionally expanded ergo. The 3v lemma repeats the world-creation clause but need not repeat every connective.
source_uncertainties.semantic_limit: Do not silently replace the whole phrase by familiar Sic mundus creatus est; assertion/comparison syntax remains somewhat open.

source_uncertainties.evidence: The compressed reading is provisionally expanded modus. A short mos-like written form is visible; the exact contraction requires further palaeographic adjudication.
source_uncertainties.semantic_limit: The manner/method reference points here without unambiguously naming a numbered operation.

source_uncertainties.reading: Hermes, tres totius mundi partes habens sapientie
source_uncertainties.evidence: Hermes is expanded from its contracted spelling. Tres is separately written before the three-parts clause. No explicit Trismegistus appears in this main-text phrase.
source_uncertainties.semantic_limit: Three parts of wisdom are claimed, but this body does not enumerate which three. Their later commentary identification is not imported into the Tabula.

source_uncertainties.evidence: Et lune is directly present, not added editorially. This is a Sun-and-Moon ending, not a Solis-only one.
source_uncertainties.semantic_limit: The closing statement reports completion of what the speaker said about the operation, not proven completion of a physical operation.

source_uncertainties.evidence: A visibly crossed/overworked letter group lies before aptatione. It can look fuit-like, but neither its exact prior reading nor cancellation status is fully secure. The normalized reading treats it provisionally as a correction trace, shown explicitly rather than silently erased.
source_uncertainties.semantic_limit: If this is an active word rather than deleted writing, the clause needs further adjudication. No new certain verb or automatic sentence completion is supplied.

clauses.content: The philosopher says the following text.
The statement is true, without falsehood, certain and most true.
The two reciprocal comparisons have the purpose of penetrating the wonders of one thing; the purpose agent is not identified.
As all things were from one through the meditation/thought of one; identity of these two indefinite referents is not imposed.
And as all things were born from this one thing through aptation; the overworked group is assumed deleted in this branch.
Its father is the Sun; its mother is the Moon.
The wind carried it in its own belly.
Its nurse is the Earth.
This is the father of all thelesm of the whole world; THIS is demonstrative, not a named place.
The force of the topic is complete if the topic has been turned into earth; this is a condition, not a new command.
You shall separate earth from fire, the subtle from the dense, gently and with great skill.
It ascends from earth to heaven.
And again it descends into earth.
It receives one force jointly qualified by upper and lower plural domains; no distributive duplication of FORCE_OF.
Thus the topic had the glory of the whole world.
And therefore all obscurity will flee from you.

This is the strong strength of the strength of the whole world, because its bearer will overcome every subtle thing and penetrate every solid thing. The nested emphatic genitive is an explicit interpretation.
As/thus therefore the world was created.
From this there will be wondrous aptations, whose manner is this; the source of the consequence and both deictic scopes remain contextual.
Therefore I am called Hermes, having three parts of the whole world's wisdom.
What I said about the operation of Sun and Moon is complete.

interpretation_policy: Every major source assertion and temporal/number feature has an explicit conceptual representation; the 19-source-unit coverage is exhaustive. This is not a literal Latin token compiler.

TOPIC coindexes parental possessors, carried object, nurse possessor, ascent/descent and receiver as one hypothetical discourse subject, without conserved mass, named substance or literal astronomical assertion.

INDEFINITE_ONE is an indefinite singular expression. Each occurrence introduces a separately scoped unspecified referent; root equality does not impose referent equality. It is not silently equal to TOPIC.
UNSPECIFIED_AGENT leaves the purpose agent existentially unspecified, with no identity to TOPIC or YOU. Its written realization is part of this explicit semantic notation hypothesis.
UPPER/LOWER name qualitative domains, not constant individual objects. PLURAL preserves the later plural construction. Neither is equated to HEAVEN/EARTH.

THIS is a context-sensitive demonstrative expression, not a shared physical location. THIS_SPECIFIED applies a demonstrative determination to a described term. FROM_THIS is a consequence/origin link with its own unresolved antecedent scope.
STRENGTH_SUBJECT is the bearer of the preceding fortitudo claim; it is not silently identical to the earlier vis. THOSE_APTATIONS refers to the newly mentioned plural aptations.

Nested STRENGTH_OF is one explicit genitive interpretation, not two physically measured forces. THELESM remains the source term, with secret/treasure as commentary-supported gloss rivals; these lexical nuances yield the same equations.

THIS_TEXT links the initial speech and final about-operation saying as one discourse span. PHILOSOPHER, I and HERMES are distinct expressions; speaker identity is a declared reading assumption, not a string equality constraint.

The overworked group after una is assumed deleted; corrected sicut, meditatione, aptatione, penetranda, quia, ergo and modus follow the marked normalized readings. Other active-letter or lexical readings are outside this finite source branch, not refuted.

Body boundary excludes the separate incompletely read rubric. The complete Philosophi-dicit frame and Sun-and-Moon closure remain. No clause-sized residual strings, zero argument omissions, BEGIN_RECORD or generic ASSERT atoms are introduced.
SOURCE token completeness does not establish uniquely recoverable meaning; contextual references, singleton roots, multiple code factorizations and the finite source-reading choices remain explicit.
